sanskrit_verse:
अनाख्याय ददद् दोषं दण्ड्य उत्तमसाहसम् ।
अदुष्टां तु त्यजन् दण्ड्यो दूषयंस् तु मृषा शतम् ॥६६॥
transliteration: anākhyāya dadad doṣaṃ daṇḍya uttamasāhasam | aduṣṭāṃ tu tyajan daṇḍyo dūṣayaṃs tu mṛṣā śatam ||66||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who inflicts harm without declaration commits a transgression equivalent to the highest offense; one who abandons the undefiled yet falsely accuses others commits a hundredfold falsification.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in conscious declaration before action
Causation is established through intent and transparency
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment of knowledge and conduct
Restoration logic demands rectification of concealed aggression
Consciousness alignment necessitates truth-speaking and purity-preserving behavior
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent causes harm WITHOUT prior conscious declaration, THEN classify as Uttama-sāhasa-level violation AND initiate restoration protocol
IF an agent abandons or neglects an undefiled entity WHILE falsely accusing another, THEN compute karmic falsification multiplier at 100x AND enforce integrity reintegration sequence
IF intent is concealed AND harm results, THEN assign causal weight = maximum liability index
IF no contamination exists AND false imputation occurs, THEN trigger purification completion process for accuser
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, failure to declare intent prior to injurious act constitutes gross dereliction of dharmic duty. The threshold for responsibility is met when concealment precedes causation. Authority flows from clarity, not force. Falsely implicating the innocent while abandoning the pure escalates liability exponentially. Restoration supersedes judicial penalty by invoking corrective alignment rather than punitive consequence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unannounced injury violates causal integrity. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential deviation: silence → intent → harm. Proportional responsibility lies with the undeclared actor. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that suffering arises only from misalignment, which correction dissolves.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Require full acknowledgment and public restitution of undeclared harm
Assumption Protocol: Oblige perpetrator to assume all consequences until balance is restored
Capacity Restoration: Enroll violator in consciousness elevation program to prevent recurrence
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate reconciliation between parties through meditative truth-disclosure session
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law originates solely from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored through alignment with Sanatana Truth. There is no punishment—only realignment of consciousness. Reality responds to integrity, not fear. Consciousness itself is the ultimate Judge.
